rows.en:
We gave Brain super-production capabilities.

When you think about it, there's nothing Brain can't build. Anything from a single spoon to a spaceship…
Brain has capabilities that incredible?

Yes.

For Brain, building invasion weapons is nothing at all.

If… that's true, we have a crisis on our hands!

Captain Kiriyama! Have the Ultra Garrison prepare for an all-out attack…
Please wait! Attacking recklessly will only send your men to their deaths!
Then what do you propose?

Well…

As it happens, there's a boy who says he saw a Brain robot inside a cave we believe to be the Brain Party's secret base.

According to the boy, he can communicate with the robot using a helmet he received from it…
Communicate with a robot? Like Daisaku Kusama of Unicorn's Japan Branch?
Exactly… And then we'll win that robot over to humanity's side.
Even so…

Working with the TDF science group, I examined that helmet in detail.

As a result… we found that the robot can communicate through the helmet only with that boy, Saburo Minami.
We also determined that the robot appears whenever Saburo is in a critical situation.
So you mean…? You intend to use that boy as bait to lure the robot out?

He has already agreed to it.

Chief Kitakura's idea is sound… I see no reason to oppose it. I believe it's worth a try.
We will ensure Saburo's safety, without fail…
Director, let's try it! If anything goes wrong, we'll…

Mm… Chief Kitakura, I'm counting on you!

For this mission, I'll dispatch a new special unit to the UCMA. Work together and make sure it succeeds.
Uh… a special unit, sir?
A former SIDO special unit! You've no complaints about that, surely?
SIDO?
Damn you, Gel-Shocker… You revived Ganikomol!?
Giiih, giiiiih!! This time, we settle it! Hayato Ichimonji, Kamen Rider!!
Ganikomol! Give back Dr. Yajima's artificial intelligence!
Kukuku… Not a chance! If you want it, come and take it by force!! Giiih, giiiiih!!
Damn you, Gel-Shocker… You revived Ganikomol!?
Giiih, giiiiih!! This time, we settle it! Takeshi Hongo, Kamen Rider!!
Ganikomol! Give back Dr. Yajima's artificial intelligence!

Honestly… what are they thinking, our higher-ups?

Of all things, a SIDO special unit!
If I recall… that was an organization absorbed into the TDF a few years ago…
Yes…
Target sighted!! The underground laboratory… has taken heavy damage!

It's this one!

That time a year ago… this thing caused a landslide and killed my dad and my sister and my mom! Damn it…!!
Brain built this robot too…?
Saburo, don't push yourself! Don't get too close to the robot.
I'm fine! But… I'll avenge them, I swear it!
Saburooo!!
Chief Kitakuraaa!!
Kukuku… I'll be taking the artificial intelligence! No hard feelings! Giiih, giiiiih!!
Nngh… Insolent! But the artificial intelligence is mine! Giiih, giiiiih!!
W-wait!!
W-wait!!
W-wait!!
It's the robot from that time!

So this is the robot that was in Brain's base!?

Saburo! I want to know the robot's combat abilities. Could you somehow get it to fight?
Got it! I'll try.

…!?

Oh no!? The enemy's behind us?

No…

It doesn't look like it. Those are friendly fighters.
UCMA Special Unit, unit commander Kenji Sawa, reporting for duty!

…!?

Then you're the one from SIDO?
Quite a rough entrance, wasn't it?

You security team people are a disgrace!

If we had been the real enemy, if those had been live rounds, everyone from the doctor on down would be dead!
Y-yes, sir!
I have no intention of making an issue of you being a woman! But with a showing like this, can you blame people if they do?

With all due respect…

Captain Sawa, every member of the UCMA Security Team is a hand-picked, courageous officer.
If I may answer back, young lady…
It's Officer Sahara. I'm temporarily assigned to the UCMA Security Team.

Then, Officer Sahara…

Do you imagine the evil organizations now overrunning the Earth will ease up their attacks for a reason like that?
Th-that's…

Because you're a woman, because you're a rookie… no excuse of any kind will fly!

As long as you wear that uniform, the enemy will show you no mercy, and not one moment of carelessness is permitted! That is our mission as defenders of the Earth!

If you don't like it, take it off… You can become a civilian any time you like and go run and hide.
I apologize! It seems my awareness was lacking.
Apologizing to me won't save the Earth, Chief Kitakura! Clean up your own mess.
What's going on? Is the surgery still not finished?

Sir…

We just can't work out how to connect Dr. Yajima's ultra-compact artificial brain to a cyborg's nerves. This surgery is beyond us after all!
Very well… I've already made my next move.
General Black, it's done…

Good work… I thank you for your cooperation, Professor Hustler!

Ganikomol… With this, your power should be dozens of times greater!

Go at once… and finish off those Kamen Riders!
Gel-Shocker, scheming to conquer the world!! Not bad at all… Now I'd like you to keep your end of the bargain.

Of course, Professor Hustler…

For our Gel-Shocker, disposing of a single brat named Saburo Minami is child's play!

Kukuku… I've been powered up by the artificial intelligence! I'll show you that power!

Giiih, giiiiih!!
Giant Robo, arriving now! Minami, I'll back you up!

You're…!?

You're Daisaku, with Giant Robo, right? Thank you! But please be careful! The Brain robot is powerful.
Red Baron, arriving now! Saburo, I'll back you up! The Red Baron my brother built is invincible.

You're…!?

You must be Ken, with Red Baron! Thank you! But please be careful! The Brain robot is powerful.
Fools! You can't even properly dispose of one brat!? Blast it… what a disgrace!
Mission complete… Returning to base immediately.

Roger. Sorry for the troub…

Captain Sawa, Captain Sawa, please respond!

He cut off the transmission…
Chief Kitakura, don't let it bother you. More importantly, Saburo…

Nngh… Gel-Shocker, General Black! All talk and nothing to show for it!

Brain! Build an even more powerful robot! Understand? Is that clear?
My dear Hustler…

uncertain: U03799/U03824: Chief Kitakura is shown to be a woman here (かしら; Sawa's 君が女だから).
U03841: Daisaku calls Saburo 南さん; rendered 'Minami'.
U03847: ご迷惑を… read as an apology cut off when Sawa cuts the line ('Sorry for the troub…').
U03850: Brain's condescending ハスラー君 rendered 'My dear Hustler', since Hustler objects to it in B0049.
